{"metadata":{"description":"Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.","id":"gh:1337511446","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"rapid-mlx-dsh-provider","slug":"raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider","topics":["apple-silicon","coding-agent","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","llm","local-llm","mlx","openai-api","rapid-mlx"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" of your settings.yaml."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @raullenchai/dsh-provider"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A native Rapid-MLX provider for
DeepSeek Harness — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server ins"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"tead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> **Status: published to npm** as
> `@raullenchai/dsh-provider`.
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in Verif"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ied was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdap"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verifi"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ed against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves f"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"ast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it does for you"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx s"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"erve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reaso"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does not"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.**"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's ca"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"pacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"'s **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + K"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"V cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `c"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"ontext_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine"},{"id":"p11s7","text":" can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a han"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"d-written number copied from another model."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"de ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Then point the agent at the route:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack o"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"n it locally instead, see
Local development."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Model management (v0.2.0)"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent c"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"an see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pul"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"l/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subp"},{"id":"p19s5","text":" CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Tool | Source | What it does |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context win"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"dow, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"--cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>`"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | "},{"id":"p21s5","text":"`rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapi"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"d-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache dis"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is"},{"id":"p23s4","text":" forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin)."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Verified"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
warning; the entry sh"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gate"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"s
Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
test pass, verified"},{"id":"p26s5","text":" independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Not done yet"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
`tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `i"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"s_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"` reports the model's
*advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
expose a usable-capacity"},{"id":"p29s6","text":" figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
`LlmError("},{"id":"p29s7","text":"..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
Text, reasoning and tool calls are"},{"id":"p29s8","text":" carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
a `rapid-m"},{"id":"p29s9","text":"lx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
(`registerAdapter` owns provider "},{"id":"p29s10","text":"exclusivity). Use one or rename ours."}],"truncated":true}
